import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('evaluation/scripts').resolve()))
from run_official_kiss_matcher import expected_transform,errors
from evaluate_external_kitti_odometry import load_reference_csv
r=Path('experiments/results/imu_dr_readme_and_retrieval')
p=json.loads((r/'matcher_protocol.json').read_text())
gt=Path('experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_00_full_gt.csv')
assert hashlib.sha256(gt.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['reference_csv_sha256']
poses=load_reference_csv(gt)
native=json.loads((r/'refined_estimates.json').read_text())
assert native['control']['maximum_matrix_error']<1e-3
assert native['protocol_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((r/'refinement_protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
coarse=json.loads((r/'matcher_run/summary.json').read_text())['cases']
rows=[]
for row in native['cases']:
 case=next(c for c in p['cases'] if c['id']==row['case'])
 reference=expected_transform(poses,case['source_frame'],case['target_frame'],0)
 rotation,translation=errors(np.array(row['transform']),reference)
 before=next(c for c in coarse if c['case']==row['case'] and c['variant']==row['variant'])
 rows.append({'case':row['case'],'variant':row['variant'],'rotation_error_deg':rotation,'translation_error_m':translation,'coarse_rotation_error_deg':before['rotation_error_deg'],'coarse_translation_error_m':before['translation_error_m'],'native_converged':row['converged'],'native_inliers':row['num_inliers'],'success':rotation<=p['success_rotation_deg'] and translation<=p['success_translation_m']})
result={'case_count':len(rows),'successes':sum(x['success'] for x in rows),'cases':rows,'analytic_control_max_matrix_error':native['control']['maximum_matrix_error'],'claim_limit':'Fixed opt-in refinement diagnostic. Offline GT scoring is not a deployable acceptance rule; four selected development candidates only.'}
(r/'refinement_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
